issues.title: Mercy Relief, HEED 방글라데시는 Ctg의 홍수 피해 가구 2,550명에게 구호품을 배포했습니다.
issues.title_en: Mercy Relief, HEED Bangladesh distribute relief to 2,550 flood-affected families in Ctg
issues.summary: HEED Bangladesh, with financial support from Mercy Relief, has distributed emergency relief supplies among 2,550 flood-affected families in Chattogram's Chandanaish and Banshkhali upazilas.
